written: 2026-10-22, after the Codex review (CODEX_REVIEW_20261022.md #5-#7) and before any JEPA result under this rule
training: teacher_anchored_joint_jepa_audit.py default adjacent_three_level: five independently trained matched hierarchy models (osler_jepa.adjacent_hierarchy.HIERARCHY_MODELS: full, direct_organ, body_mediated, organ_route, system_only), identical initialization and per-stage epoch budget; structurally disabled stages are skipped
anchors: build_expert_anchor_columns.py: every row, label-independent, recipes fitted on MIMIC patients outside the JEPA cohort
patient_roles: held-out MIMIC calibration patients split by osler_jepa.patient_split: selection patients choose the path and fit point/interval scales; conformal patients give only conformal scores
deployment_form: jepa_deployment_form_dev.deploy: shared deployment clock, outcomes used only after label_available_hr, warm-up stays unscored; online point correction and DtACI from the configs below
path_choice: on selection patients: a hierarchy model is eligible when it beats each matched ablation (patient-cluster paired bootstrap, CI upper bound < 0); lowest-MAE eligible model is chosen; system_only never takes over
seed_pass_per_database: chosen model beats the frozen expert anchor on the database's point axes (eICU: patient and hospital; single-site: patient)
chosen model beats persistence on the same axes
chosen model beats each matched ablation and the trained no-route model (system_only) on the same axes
chosen model's interval gate passes (eICU: patient and hospital; single-site: patient and care unit)
cell_pass: a database:cell passes a MIMIC sample only if all 7 seeds pass; robust if it passes in >= 80% of samples; promotion additionally needs >= 5 samples and passing on every evaluable database
